seoTitle: Protein Intake Calculator (Daily Grams by Goal)
metaDescription: Get a daily protein range in grams from your body weight and training goal, using the ISSN position stand ranges for exercisers, plus a split across meals.
intro: Get a daily protein range in grams from your weight and training goal.
why:
Pick your body weight and a goal. The ranges come from the ISSN position stand on protein and exercise: 1.4 to 2.0 g per kg for most exercisers, lower for endurance work and higher for strength work, and 2.3 to 3.1 g per kg when lifting while cutting calories. The page also splits the total across your meals.

The 0.8 g per kg line is the commonly quoted adult RDA for people who do not train. Check the figure for your country. People with kidney disease should ask a doctor before raising protein.
howTo: Choose kg or lb and enter your body weight.
Pick the goal that fits your training.
Set how many meals you eat a day.
Read the daily range and the grams per meal.

faq.q: Do I use total body weight?
faq.a: Most guidance uses actual body weight. People with a lot of excess weight sometimes use a target weight instead; a dietitian can advise.
No. Gains flatten out within the ranges shown. Extra protein mostly adds calories.
No. It is an estimate from a published formula. A doctor or dietitian can judge your own case far better.
No. The work happens in your browser and the page makes no network request with your input.
